verifiedRecords.notes: Use a uniformly random permutation and an assigned flag per vertex. An unassigned vertex becomes a pivot; scan its positive list and assign only unassigned neighbors to its cluster. Pivots form an independent set in G⁺, so each positive edge has at most one pivot endpoint and is queried at most once. At most n degree queries, m⁺ neighbor queries, O(n) permutation/flag/output work; total O(n+m⁺). The induced pivot distribution matches uniform selection from remaining vertices.
verifiedRecords.sourceLimit: The journal pseudocode loops over remaining vertices and does not itself state an O(n+m⁺) adjacency-list implementation theorem. Label the bound as implementation-derived.
verifiedRecords.correction: Changed expected work to a per-outcome implementation-derived resource bound; retained the expected approximation guarantee.
